UpdateConvention.document:
mutation UpdateConvention($input: UpdateConventionInput!) {
  updateConvention(input: $input) {
    convention {
      id
      ...ConventionAdminConventionFields
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

  id
  accepting_proposals
  starts_at
  ends_at
  canceled
  name

  email_from
  email_mode
  event_mailing_list_domain
  location
  language
  timezone_name
  timezone_mode
  show_schedule
  show_event_list
  hidden
  maximum_tickets
  ticket_name
  ticketNamePlural
  clickwrap_agreement
  ticket_mode
  site_mode
  signup_mode
  signup_automation_mode
  signup_requests_open
  queue_no_ticket_reminder_advance_seconds
  stripe_account_ready_to_charge
  favicon {
    id
    url
    __typename
  }
  open_graph_image {
    id
    url
    __typename
  }
  stripe_account {
    id
    email
    charges_enabled
    display_name
    __typename
  }
  signup_rounds {
    id
    start
    maximum_event_signups
    ranked_choice_order
    __typename
  }
  defaultLayout {
    id

    __typename
  }
  cmsLayouts {
    id
    name
    __typename
  }
  rootPage {
    id
    name
    __typename
  }
  cmsPages {

    name
    __typename
  }
  staff_positions {
    id
    name
    __typename
  }
  catch_all_staff_position {
    id
    name
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

EventProposalsAdminQuery.document:
query EventProposalsAdminQuery($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $filters: EventProposalFiltersInput, $sort: [SortInput!]) {
  convention: conventionByRequestHost {
    id
    timezone_name
    starts_at
    ends_at
    event_categories(current_ability_can_read_event_proposals: true) {
      id
      name
      default_color
      __typename
    }
    event_proposals_paginated(
      page: $page
      per_page: $perPage
      filters: $filters
      sort: $sort
    ) {
      total_entries
      total_pages
      current_page
      per_page
      entries {
        id
        title
        length_seconds
        status
        submitted_at
        updated_at
        form_response_attrs_json
        event_category {
          id
          name
          default_color
          __typename
        }
        registration_policy {
          minimum_slots
          total_slots
          slots_limited
          __typename
        }
        owner {
          id
          name_inverted
          gravatar_enabled
          gravatar_url
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

ScheduleGridConventionDataQuery.document:
query ScheduleGridConventionDataQuery {
  currentAbility {
    can_create_cms_partials
    __typename
  }
  convention: conventionByRequestHost {
    id
    blockPartial(name: PRE_SCHEDULE_TEXT) {
      id
      content
      content_html
      current_ability_can_update
      current_ability_can_delete
      __typename
    }
    ...CommonConventionData
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}
fragment CommonConventionData on Convention {
  id
  name
  starts_at
  ends_at
  signup_mode
  signup_automation_mode
  site_mode
  timezone_name
  timezone_mode
  ticket_name
  ticket_mode
  event_categories {
    id
    name
    scheduling_ui
    default_color
    full_color
    signed_up_color
    team_member_name
    teamMemberNamePlural
    event_form {
      id
      form_sections {
        id
        form_items {
          id
          public_description
          default_value
          ...CommonFormItemFields
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}
fragment CommonFormItemFields on FormItem {
  id
  position
  identifier
  item_type
  rendered_properties
  default_value
  visibility
  writeability
  expose_in
  __typename
}
